## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally (CI runs the same script, so this shouldn't surprise you)
- [ ] Any new category or country is registered in `taxonomy/categories.yaml`
- [ ] The URL isn't already in the directory
- [ ] `date_added` is a **quoted** ISO date, e.g. `"2026-08-22"`
- [ ] Entry slug (the filename) is unique within its collection
